comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This discovery helps to unlock the following quest:

Tiger survey in the wintry region
8-star Adventure Quest from Calicut
Eco Research r8, Biology r10, Korean (not needed to pull the quest, nor complete it)

Steps:
1. Calicut - Talk to Calicut Adventure Guild Master × 2
2. Pohang - Talk to Tavern Keeper
3. Pohang - Talk to Young Man × 3
4. Pohang - Talk to Port Official × 2
5. Sea of ​​Okhotsk - Use Ecological Research at 6324,2224

Because of where the discovery is found (Sea of Okhotsk), charting the Northeast Passage for Mercator may also be required.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=3693
